svg.title: catalunya-2021 authentic F1 circuit outline
svg.desc: Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Formula1_Circuit_Catalunya_2021.svg; creator: GabrielStella; based on Will Pittenger / Sentoan; license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). PitPitch adaptation: isolate exact original route path, omit all labels, numbers, pit lanes, sector colours and background, recolour black and crop empty margin. Derivative distributed under CC-BY-SA-3.0. Original SHA-256: 4b2afb8e4d0bbba9a792243287371a5dc54c72fcf8be38cea52153894134e2c4.
Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
